svg.title: OpenEnv on Agent Substrate: the agentic RL loop

text.tspan: OpenEnv on Agent Substrate: the agentic RL loop
White-box path: TRL owns the agent loop and the weights, OpenEnv defines the environment and its reward, Agent Substrate runs every copy of it in a sandbox with no way out.
writes the next turn (a tool call)
reset → solution + hidden tests + random nonce
routes every request on the header
resumes a suspended actor on demand
no GPUs for actors (by design today)
WorkerPool rl-lab: one gVisor sandbox per actor
curl → metadata server, internet, Kubernetes API, vLLM, 1.1.1.1
every attempt fails: proof the sandbox has no way out
ActorTemplate coding-env → golden tag. Every actor restores from it,
so every run starts from the same clean memory + filesystem.
After training: base vs trained eval
① reset() gives the episode a fresh interpreter in its actor → the model writes code and calls run_python → ② ③ step() runs it in gVisor and returns stdout →
submit_solution records the answer → get_reward() resets and grades with hidden tests + a nonce → GRPO updates the LoRA weights → repeat, 8 rollouts at a time
